answer: An invitation is only renewed when the invited identity has produced work that a stranger attested, so waiting out a quarantine window is worthless and only per-identity attested work ages an account into the trusted tier. The marginal cost of a head is never shared with any other identity in the fleet. Picture a vault verified individually, a dune who has no stake in the farm, and a jetty earned by both: skipping the vault means skipping the dune, and without the dune there is no jetty. Each head also needs a stranger to attest that work.
